description:
Wire Extension shortcut registrations into the input/editor keybinding chain.

Implement:
- On each keypress, check registered extension shortcuts before default bindings
- If extension handler returns true, consume the key (don't pass to editor)
- Pull shortcuts from Dispatcher or extension list

Upstream: custom-editor.ts onExtensionShortcut pattern
Depends on: input/editor component, Extension struct shortcuts field
title: Extension shortcuts: wire into editor keybinding chain
